prompt: Build a settings screen with a list of options the user can turn on and off, plus a dropdown to pick a language and a small hint text explaining each option.
response:
<bl-switch checked>Enable notifications</bl-switch>
<bl-switch checked>Dark mode</bl-switch>
<bl-switch>Reduce motion</bl-switch>
<bl-select label="Language" help-text="Choose your preferred language." placeholder="Select a language">
  <bl-select-option value="en" label="English">English</bl-select-option>
  <bl-select-option value="de" label="Deutsch">Deutsch</bl-select-option>
  <bl-select-option value="tr" label="Türkçe">Türkçe</bl-select-option>
</bl-select>
